## Summary

20 years building and shipping web products for organizations around the world — most recently as a Senior Front-End Developer on enterprise platforms across government, nonprofit, and membership sectors. Hands-on specialty: web accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508).

## Skills

### Front-End
HTML5, CSS3 / SASS, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript (ES6+), jQuery, PHP, Twig, Gulp, Git / SVN, responsive development

### Accessibility
WCAG 2.2 AA, ADA, Section 508 — auditing & remediation with axe, WAVE, Lighthouse, PowerMapper; hands-on screen-reader testing with NVDA and VoiceOver

### CMS
Drupal, WordPress

### UX / UI Design
Figma, Adobe XD, component-based & modular development, wireframes, style guides

## Work Experience

**2006–present — Freelancer (own clients)**
Web development and digital strategy for my own clients, alongside agency and in-house roles. Contracts and invoices go through my Brazilian company.

**2018–2026 — Senior Front-End Developer @ Taoti Creative (taoti.com)**
While at Taoti, worked on enterprise Drupal and WordPress sites for Taoti's clients, including The German Marshall Fund of the United States, International Women's Forum, APTA, IAAPA, and others. Led accessibility (A11Y) auditing and remediation. Built component-based front-end interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Twig, Tailwind CSS, and Lando. Integrated AI tools into daily workflows via Figma MCP integration and AI-assisted debugging.

**2017 — Visual Design Engineer @ Crossover (crossover.com)**
Contributed to Acquia client project. Owned SCSS / styling architecture for the Kitewheel MVP through to launch.

**2012–2016 — UX/UI Designer & Front-End Developer @ Printi (printi.com.br)**
Early team member. Designed UX/UI for new features and translated layouts into front-end code. Contributed during Printi's growth period (Best B2B Company by Brazil Founders, 2014 & 2015).

**2008–2019 — Writer @ Abduzeedo (abduzeedo.com)**
Contributed to one of the world's most recognized design blogs — inspiration pieces, ideas, and interviews for the global design community.

**2006–2012 — Web Developer @ Zee Design (zee.com.br)**
Full design solutions: UX/UI, responsive design, front-end development, wireframes, prototypes, and style guides.
